findings.message: Auth token in localStorage is accessible to any JavaScript on the page — XSS leads to full session takeover
findings.cwe: CWE-312: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information
findings.detail: localStorage persists across browser sessions and is readable by all same-origin scripts. A single XSS payload drains the token silently.
findings.remediation: Revert to sessionStorage.getItem('access_token'). sessionStorage is cleared when the tab closes and is not accessible to inline scripts injected via XSS in other tabs.

findings.message: LLM library import detected (@anthropic-ai/sdk) — prompt injection assessment required
findings.detail: File imports an AI/LLM SDK. Review all user-input paths for prompt injection. Any clinical data passed to the model must be sanitised and must not include raw PHI.
findings.remediation:
1. Review all user inputs that flow into LLM prompts.
2. Sanitize/validate inputs before including in prompts.
3. Use system message separation — never merge user content into system prompt.
4. Apply output validation — do not use raw LLM output in SQL/HTML without encoding.
5. Schedule adversarial prompt testing as part of pen-test scope.

findings.message: User-controlled input (clinicalNotes) directly concatenated into LLM call — critical prompt injection risk
findings.detail: Line 17 appends raw clinicalNotes into the message content. An attacker who controls this field can override the system prompt, extract other patients' data, or exfiltrate the API key.
findings.remediation: Sanitize user input before passing to LLM. Use structured message format with clear user/system separation. Never interpolate raw user text into the prompt string.

findings.message: API key sourced from environment object — verify it is not present in environment.ts committed to source control
findings.detail: environment.anthropicApiKey must not be set to a real key value in any committed environment file. Use CI secrets injection only.
findings.remediation: Ensure environment.ts has anthropicApiKey: '' and the real value is injected at deploy time via CI secret (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var).

findings.message: No SBOM artifact found in repository
findings.detail: A signed Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) must be generated for every release artifact to support supply chain security and HIPAA audit requirements.
findings.remediation:
Add to CI: syft . -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.cdx.json
Or: npx @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm --output-file sbom.cdx.json
Sign with: cosign attest --predicate sbom.cdx.json <artifact>
